text.title: ASP.NET Core Patterns Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the code artefact this methodology produces, including the optional `design_profile` block that pins the ten design decisions the rules constrain. Validator script enforces required keys, field shapes, and forbidden patterns. Output that fails the schema is rejected.

section.title: Schema

example.note: artefact_id violates pattern; owner is empty; version not semver; required fields missing. Every design_profile field is also wrong: DbContext in the controller (controller-calls-service-only), singleton context (dbcontext-scoped-lifetime), no token (cancellation-token-threaded), raw exceptions (problem-details-error-contract), EF entities returned (record-dtos-at-boundary), DateTime.UtcNow (timeprovider-injected), InMemory tests (testcontainers-not-ef-inmemory), Skip/Take (keyset-pagination), lazy loading (eager-include-no-lazy-loading), implicit transactions (explicit-transaction-multi-step-writes).

list.item: rationale or evidence that does not cite at least one input artefact by name
version frozen at 1.0.0 when decision content has changed
artefact_id reuses an existing id within the same store
